title: More Pets
description: Adds more vanilla+ pets to minecraft!
body:
# More Pets by JellkaGamez
The vanilla pets can get pretty boring at times.

## What you can do
This mod lets you find new pets such as
- The Dachshund
- - The Dachshund has multiple skins that you can choose between with nametags!
- there will be more in future updates!

## How you can get it
You can get the new pets by finding them in the wild!

## Why would you want more pets?
The vanilla wolfs, and cats can get boring at times or you can simply have new pets alongside the vanilla pets!
